steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In February 2024, a guest on Equity Mates explained Corporate Travel Management managed travel for medium to large corporates, mostly online with a call centre, and had global operations across every continent serving many multinational clients.

episode.title: It's all in the name - Corporate Travel Management | Summer Series

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In May 2024, Equity Mates said profits were hit when a UK government contract delivered only a couple of million dollars instead of the expected 30 to 40 million, leading to downgraded guidance and a weaker share price.

episode.title: Buy or Sell: Adam Keily with Scott Phillips - Qantas, Pilbara, Cochlear & more

views.text: In February 2024, a guest on Equity Mates highlighted risks to long-term performance, citing key person risk with the founder as the driving force and concern if organic growth lagged beyond normal economic cycles.

episode.title: It's all in the name - Corporate Travel Management | Summer Series

steps.q: Can it reinvest its profits productively?

views.text: In February 2024, Equity Mates discussed growth depending on expanding global market share and operating in industry niches, noting the company had been acquiring businesses as part of its strategy.

episode.title: It's all in the name - Corporate Travel Management | Summer Series

steps.q: Can it be bought at a reasonable price?

views.text: In May 2024, Equity Mates noted the shares traded at $15.09 and that the price had fallen after guidance was downgraded when the UK government contract delivered far less profit than expected.

episode.title: Buy or Sell: Adam Keily with Scott Phillips - Qantas, Pilbara, Cochlear & more
